messages:
Alex P: Heads up 1 1 We're rolling a native SDK binary ABI update (ABI v2) next month. This will touch the C++/Rust native bindings that some hardware partners and SIs embed. Need a partner-facing migration plan.
Maeve (partners): Copy. Which partners and marketplace images are at risk?
Samir (eng): Immediate list: NebulaHW, AtlasSI, CloudBroker, and a handful of customers with custom native plugins. We'll produce a compatibility matrix with specific symbol changes.
Priya (platform): Marketplace constraint: we can't break existing marketplace images. Do we have a nonbreaking path?
Samir (eng): Yes were shipping a compatibility shim behind a runtime feature flag: enable_native_abi_v2_shim. Shim provides v1 symbols mapping to v2 internals. Plan is 90-day support window after GA.
Jin (si-lead): Great. Concern: shim perf/regression. What's the expected impact?
Samir (eng): Benchmarks show a ~4-7% tail latency increase in worst-case KV-heavy flows. We'll publish per-workload numbers. Shim has two modes: full-emulation (max compatibility) and fast-path (reduced compat but better perf).
Elena (pm-marketplace): Marketplace items: image tags and a visible deprecation banner. Recommend tags like redwood-native:v1-compat and v2. Also add a checkbox on partner marketplace pages "Validated for ABI v2".
Maeve (partners): Proposed partner test window: 2 weeks dedicated validation + 4-week canary flip. Engineering okay with that cadence?
Samir (eng): Yes. Tentative schedule: week 0 - partners pull shim builds; week 1 - joint smoke tests; weeks 2-5 - staggered canary flips; week 6 - new installs default to v2 (shim opt-in); day 90 - shim removal.
Priya (platform): We'll add a partner-scoped toggle in Console with an automated rollback if error rate > 2.5% over 10m. Need Platform eng to add the toggle API & UI.
Samir (eng): Assigning Sam to work with Priya on the toggle API.
Jin (si-lead): For SIs, we need a small binary-compat test harness and a symbol-check script. Samir, can you produce that?
Samir (eng): Yes. Example early handshake test: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/runtime/handshake \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PARTNER_KEY" \
  -d '{"abi_version":"v2"}'
```
Samir (eng): Also pushing a native symbol validator to partner repos. It scans exported symbols and highlights renamed/moved symbols.
Maeve (partners): I'll open the partner advisory doc and add Legal + partner contacts. LegalBot, please review any public messaging.
LegalBot: Reminder 1 All copy that implies continued compatibility or SLA guarantees requires prior legal approval. Add the draft to Legal review.
Elena (pm-marketplace): Communications timeline: internal partner notice next week, public docs & marketplace banner two weeks after that, direct customer emails one week before hard cut. Need sign-off from Legal and Marketplace ops.
DeployBot: Canary rollout scheduled 2025-06-10 03:00 UTC. Can be rescheduled by @Priya.
Maeve (partners): Action items assigned: I'll run outreach and log partner acceptance; Jin will coordinate SI validation; Samir will drop artifacts (shim builds, test scripts, symbol validator); Priya will add Console toggle; Elena will draft marketplace banners; Legal to review wording.
Alex P: Also include a one-page migration checklist for partners: build flag, symbols to check, handshake curl, rollback steps. Keep it minimal for SIs to embed in their release trains.
Samir (eng): Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-partners/native_abi_v2/ and will share signed links in the partner doc.
Maeve (partners): Thanks all. I'll set up a Thursday sync 10am PT for partners. We'll treat this thread as primary source for commitments. :thumbsup:
